caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table with an oval-shaped top. The table is brown in color, with a polished surface that gives it a smooth, reflective appearance. The table has eight legs, all of which are turned and feature decorative, bulbous segments. The legs are connected by a series of horizontal stretchers, also turned and matching the style of the legs, forming an intricate framework beneath the tabletop. The stretchers intersect near the bottom of the legs, further stabilizing the structure. The background of the drawing is plain and a light beige color, without any additional objects or visual elements. The table is presented in a side perspective, showing both the top and the arrangement of legs and stretchers. There is a faint signature by the artist at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Gate-legged Table
